4694-4802-7272-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-7272-7306.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1531-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4381-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

2131-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

728-2060-2946-6701.notablePrerequisites: You've had a non-Skeleton creature die under your control this turn.
728-2060-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
728-2060-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

465-728-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-1843-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-1843-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-3197-3263-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-3263-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1442-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Ishkanah.
When Ishkanah enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1874-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1792-4404-7183.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-7183.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Gathering Stone.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4369-6096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-6096.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, General Kreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3536-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-3761-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat from step 2

5170-5686-6132-6634.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4068-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
You control at least one Mountain.
57-4068-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1477-1778-4053-6989.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2267-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

862-2173-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

101-972-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
101-972-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker and the Great Whale token.
When the Vampire Charmseeker and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
101-972-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Vampire Charmseeker instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

339-677-2921-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

826-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
826-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2178-3652-5226.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5226.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

465-618-2292.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

5938-5959.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
5938-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
5938-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Flare of Duplication, with the copy targeting the original Flare of Duplication.
Resolve the copy of Flare of Duplication, copying the original Flare of Duplication, with the copy targeting the original Flare of Duplication.
Repeat step 5.

215-1003-2757-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
215-1003-2757-5705.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Phyrexian Walker, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Forest.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If desired, once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite {C}, and then you may forego tapping or sacrificing them on future iterations to get infinite creature tokens.

654-1315-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
654-1315-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-2736-5096-5361.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2736-5096-5361.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

4316-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

647-914-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
647-914-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1833-2178-4050-4536-4647.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goldberry.
Goldberry does not have summoning sickness.
Goldberry and Stormbound Geist do not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1833-2178-4050-4536-4647.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {U}.
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability and Goldberry trigger twice.
Resolve both Stormbound Geist triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first Goldberry trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Goldberry's first ability by tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Stormbound Geist onto Goldberry.
Resolve the second Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto Teysa, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

397-2557-3868.notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token, and at least one creature.
397-2557-3868.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and another creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1164-2575-3278-5103.notablePrerequisites:
Narset does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Narset.
You have at least three other cards in exile.
1164-2575-3278-5103.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it.
Holding priority, activate Scrabbling Claws by tapping it, causing you to exile Mirror of Fate from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mirror of Fate ability, choosing itself, Temporal Mastery and three to five other cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top, ensuring Temporal Mastery and Mirror of Fate are the topmost cards.
Declare Narset as an attacker.
Narset triggers, exiling the top four cards of your library and allowing you to cast them from exile this turn without paying their mana costs.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Temporal Mastery from exile without paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Mastery.
Cast Mirror of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat each turn.
